name: [UPDATE] Build and Burn
desc:
🔧 BUILD THE ENGINE. BURN THE STRIP. 🔥 dont forget to like and join our community!!

NEW UPDATE SOON!!!

🌃 CHAPTER 3: TOKYO NIGHTS 🌃
⏰ LIVE NOW !!!
A whole new chapter is on its way. The lights are coming on somewhere a long way from the desert... 👀
Beat The Sheriff before Saturday so you’re ready to go the second it drops. Check the countdown in the lobby!


Build your own engine, drop it in your car and race the quarter mile! Upgrade turbos, nitrous, gearbox and tyres, tune it on the dyno, and beat 50 rivals and 5 bosses in every chapter.

🏁 Chapter 1: The Strip
🏜️ Chapter 2: The Desert
🌃 CHAPTER 3: TOKYO NIGHTS

Race your friends, paint your ride and claim your daily reward!

Which one will be yours? 👀
